summary: Teesside International aerodrome closed and its airspace deactivated during 1800-1845 and 2000-2030 due to controller breaks.
text:
TEESSIDE INTERNATIONAL CTA/CTR/ATZ DEACTIVATED. AD CLSD. ATS NOT 
AVBL DUE MANDATED CONTROLLER BREAKS. HELIMED MAY STILL OPR FM THE 
HEL EMERG SERVICES BASES. PILOTS TRANSITTING THE AREA ARE ADVISED TO 
MONITOR CH119.805. TIMES MAY BE SUBJ TO SHORT NOTICE CHANGE. ALL DEP 
MUST BE AIRBORNE 10 MIN BFR CLOSURE.
